test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The income and expenditure account is a real account.
The receipts and payments account is a summary of all the capital receipts and payments.
Income and expenditure relating to special funds should not be dealt with in the income and expenditure account.
Payment of honorarium is treated as a capital expenditure.

solution:
The correct answer is **Income and expenditure relating to special funds should not be dealt with in the income and expenditure account.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Income and expenditure relating to special funds should not be dealt with in the income and expenditure account:**

 
 
• Special funds are designated for specific purposes and are separate from the general income and expenditure of an organization.
 
• Examples include endowment funds, building funds, and scholarship funds.
 
• Transactions related to these funds are recorded in separate accounts to ensure they are used for their intended purposes.
 
• By keeping these transactions separate, organizations maintain financial transparency and accountability.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The income and expenditure account is a real account:**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect. The income and expenditure account is a nominal account, not a real account. It records revenue and expenses over a specific period and determines the surplus or deficit.
 
 
 
• **The receipts and payments account is a summary of all the capital receipts and payments:**
 
 
• This statement is incorrect. The receipts and payments account is a summary of all cash transactions, both capital and revenue, over a specific period. It does not exclusively summarize capital receipts and payments.
 
 
 
• **Payment of honorarium is treated as a capital expenditure:**
 
 
• This statement is incorrect. Payment of honorarium is treated as a revenue expenditure. It is a payment for services rendered and is recorded as an expense in the income and expenditure account.
